attr.title: Pokemon Fulldex
attr.desc: The DS and GBA Pokemon games as one widescreen picture: Black 2, White 2, Black, White, HeartGold, SoulSilver, Platinum, Diamond, Pearl, Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, FireRed and LeafGreen, run on built-in melonDS and mGBA cores.
attr.inst: Copy your own DS and GBA ROMs (any names) to ports/pokemonfulldex/roms.
attr.inst_md: Copy your own DS and GBA ROMs (any names) to `ports/pokemonfulldex/roms`.
